test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ op _ mo _ n _ _ pnmop _
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• mpnmno → **m** op **p** / mo **n** n / **m n** pn / mop **o**
 
• mnmopn → **m** op **n /** mo **m** n / **n o** pn / mop **n**
 
• mnpmon → **m** op **n** / mo **p** n / **m o** pn / mop **n**
 
• pmnopn → **p** op **m** / mo **n** n / **o p** pn / mop **n**

 
• In option 3, mopn is repeated.

Hence, '**mnpmon**' is the correct answer.
